last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 22
last_episode_to_air.overview: As Ertan follows the clues, they lead him to an increasingly darker place, while the developments surrounding the Bakizade Foundation begin to draw attention. Unable to hear from Ertan, Asya pursues her suspicions. Meanwhile, a small detail noticed within the foundation is powerful enough to crack open the door to a truth that has been hidden for a long time. At the end of this story, will the accounts of years finally be settled, allowing the guilty to face their punishment and the good to prevail?

name: Lovers & Liars
overview: Ertan Aydin is one of Istanbul’s top lawyers, confident, calculating, and trained by his father to win at any cost. When his father dies suddenly, Ertan learns he was hiding a secret that could upend everything he thought he knew about himself. To protect that secret, Ertan enlists Asya, a street-smart con artist struggling to keep her family afloat. Together, they stage a dangerous deception inside one of the country’s most powerful families. Asya thinks she’s using Ertan to escape her debts. Ertan thinks he’s using her to protect his name. But the game quickly turns personal, as lies become leverage, alliances shift, and emotions cloud the plan. In a world where truth is just another trick, Ertan and Asya will learn that the biggest con may be the one they’re playing on themselves.
